name: Lion
hint: Known as the king of the jungle.
s_hint: Starts with 'L' and lives in prides.

name: Tiger
hint: The largest wild cat species with orange fur and black stripes.
s_hint: Starts with 'T' and loves swimming.

name: Elephant
hint: The largest living land animal.
s_hint: Starts with 'E' and has a long trunk.

name: Giraffe
hint: The tallest living terrestrial animal.
s_hint: Starts with 'G' and has a very long neck.

name: Zebra
hint: An African equine with distinctive black-and-white stripes.
s_hint: Starts with 'Z' and looks like a striped horse.

name: Kangaroo
hint: A marsupial native to Australia that hops.
s_hint: Starts with 'K' and carries babies in a pouch.

name: Penguin
hint: A flightless black-and-white bird adapted for swimming.
s_hint: Starts with 'P' and lives mostly in the Southern Hemisphere.

name: Dolphin
hint: An intelligent marine mammal known for echolocation.
s_hint: Starts with 'D' and jumps out of ocean waves.

name: Panda
hint: A bear native to China that eats almost exclusively bamboo.
s_hint: Starts with 'P' and has black patches around its eyes.

name: Cheetah
hint: The fastest land animal.
s_hint: Starts with 'C' and has black tear tracks on its face.

name: Wolf
hint: A wild canine that hunts in packs.
s_hint: Starts with 'W' and is the ancestor of domestic dogs.

name: Fox
hint: A small omnivorous mammal with a bushy tail.
s_hint: Starts with 'F' and is often reddish-orange.

name: Bear
hint: A large, heavy mammal that often hibernates in winter.
s_hint: Starts with 'B' and loves honey and salmon.

name: Eagle
hint: A large bird of prey with powerful vision.
s_hint: Starts with 'E' and builds high cliff or tree nests.

name: Shark
hint: A predatory fish with a cartilaginous skeleton.
s_hint: Starts with 'S' and has multiple rows of replaceable teeth.

name: Octopus
hint: A soft-bodied sea creature with eight arms.
s_hint: Starts with 'O' and has three hearts.

name: Chameleon
hint: A lizard famous for changing skin color.
s_hint: Starts with 'C' and has eyes that move independently.

name: Flamingo
hint: A tall wading bird with bright pink feathers.
s_hint: Starts with 'F' and often stands on one leg.

name: Koala
hint: An arboreal Australian marsupial that sleeps up to 20 hours a day.
s_hint: Starts with 'K' and eats eucalyptus leaves.

name: Crocodile
hint: A large semi-aquatic reptile with a powerful bite.
s_hint: Starts with 'C' and lurks in tropical rivers.
